rarity.too_strong: Too strong for this rarity: make it rarer (Legendary: ban it)
rarity.too_weak: Too weak: make it more common

lists.title: Proposed: forbidden
lists.description: Unfair cards (locks, stall, one-turn-win loops). Agree = keep them out of the game.

items.name: Chaos Emperor Dragon - Envoy of the End
items.context: Sends every card in both hands and on the field to the GY; named OUT by the owner. (category: board and hand wipe; confidence: high)

items.name: Yata-Garasu
items.context: Yata-lock: skips the opponent's draw every turn once their hand and field are empty. (category: lock turn skip; confidence: high)

items.name: Arcana Force XXI - The World
items.context: Skips the opponent's whole turn every turn with a token/fodder engine - endless lock. (category: lock turn skip; confidence: high)

items.name: Time Seal
items.context: Opponent skips their next draw; Yata-style lock piece. (category: lock turn skip; confidence: high)

items.name: Imperial Order
items.context: Negates all Spells for the whole game for a small LP cost. (category: lock floodgate; confidence: high)

items.name: Royal Oppression
items.context: Negates every Special Summon on demand; summon floodgate. (category: lock floodgate; confidence: high)

items.name: Royal Decree
items.context: Negates all other Traps on the field permanently. (category: lock floodgate; confidence: high)

items.name: Vanity's Fiend
items.context: Neither player can Special Summon; named by the owner. (category: lock floodgate; confidence: high)

items.name: Vanity's Emptiness
items.context: Neither player can Special Summon; continuous Trap floodgate. (category: lock floodgate; confidence: high)

items.name: Vanity's Ruler
items.context: Opponent cannot Special Summon at all (one-sided). (category: lock floodgate; confidence: high)

items.name: Majesty's Fiend
items.context: Neither player can activate monster effects. (category: lock floodgate; confidence: high)

items.name: Fossil Dyna Pachycephalo
items.context: Wipes Special Summoned monsters and stops all Special Summons. (category: lock floodgate; confidence: high)

items.name: Archlord Kristya
items.context: Self-summoning 2800 boss that also stops all Special Summons and returns to the Deck top. (category: lock floodgate; confidence: medium)

items.name: Barrier Statue of the Abyss
items.context: No Special Summons except one Attribute - attribute floodgate. (category: lock floodgate; confidence: medium)

items.name: Barrier Statue of the Drought
items.context: No Special Summons except one Attribute - attribute floodgate. (category: lock floodgate; confidence: medium)

items.name: Barrier Statue of the Heavens
items.context: No Special Summons except one Attribute - attribute floodgate. (category: lock floodgate; confidence: medium)

items.name: Barrier Statue of the Inferno
items.context: No Special Summons except one Attribute - attribute floodgate. (category: lock floodgate; confidence: medium)

items.name: Barrier Statue of the Stormwinds
items.context: No Special Summons except one Attribute - attribute floodgate. (category: lock floodgate; confidence: medium)

items.name: Barrier Statue of the Torrent
items.context: No Special Summons except one Attribute - attribute floodgate. (category: lock floodgate; confidence: medium)

items.name: Anti-Spell Fragrance
items.context: All Spells must be Set and wait a turn; cripples every Spell-based deck. (category: lock floodgate; confidence: medium)

items.name: Gozen Match
items.context: Each player may control only 1 Attribute; built-in lock for mono decks. (category: lock floodgate; confidence: medium)

items.name: Rivalry of Warlords
items.context: Each player may control only 1 Type; built-in lock for mono decks. (category: lock floodgate; confidence: medium)

items.name: Summon Limit
items.context: Caps both players at 2 Summons per turn; anti-combo floodgate. (category: lock floodgate; confidence: medium)

items.name: Mistake
items.context: Neither player can search the Deck; continuous floodgate. (category: lock floodgate; confidence: medium)

items.name: Non-Fusion Area
items.context: Neither player can Fusion Summon - shuts off one of this format's two Extra Deck mechanics. (category: lock floodgate; confidence: medium)

items.name: Evilswarm Ophion
items.context: Easy Rank 4 that stops all Level 5+ Special Summons (Fusion/Xyz bosses) and searches. (category: lock floodgate; confidence: medium)

items.name: Mask of Restrict
items.context: Neither player can Tribute; locks out Tribute-Summon bosses. (category: lock floodgate; confidence: low)

items.name: Gravity Bind
items.context: Level 4+ monsters can never attack; classic stall for FTK/alt-win decks. (category: lock stall; confidence: medium)

items.name: Level Limit - Area B
items.context: Forces all Level 4+ monsters into Defense Position; stall. (category: lock stall; confidence: medium)

items.name: Messenger of Peace
items.context: Monsters with 1500+ ATK cannot attack for 100 LP per turn; stall. (category: lock stall; confidence: medium)

items.name: Wall of Revealing Light
items.context: Pay LP once, opponent's monsters can't attack; stall for burn/alt-win decks. (category: lock stall; confidence: medium)

items.name: Red Screen
items.context: Opponent's monsters cannot declare attacks (1000 LP per turn); stall. (category: lock stall; confidence: medium)

items.name: D.D. Borderline
items.context: Neither player can conduct a Battle Phase while you have no Spells in GY; stall. (category: lock stall; confidence: low)

items.name: Magical Explosion
items.context: Burn OTK engine: 200 per Spell in GY with an empty hand (Empty Jar / burn FTK decks). (category: ftk otk engine; confidence: medium)

items.name: Chain Material
items.context: Fusion from Deck/GY/field for free; core of Ancient Gear / Power Bond FTKs. (category: ftk otk engine; confidence: medium)

items.name: Cannon Soldier
items.context: Unlimited Tribute-for-500 burn; loops with token/revival engines (Mass Driver already banned in 2014). (category: burn loop; confidence: medium)

items.name: Cannon Soldier MK-2
items.context: Unlimited Tribute-2-for-1500 burn; same loop as Cannon Soldier. (category: burn loop; confidence: low)

items.name: Wind-Up Magician
items.context: Engine of the Wind-Up hand loop (Rat/Shark/Hunter) that strips the opponent's whole hand. (category: hand loop; confidence: medium)

lists.title: Proposed: max 1 per deck
lists.description: Softer cases: playable, but only 1 copy per deck.

items.name: Spell Canceller
items.context: Imperial Order on a monster body; removable, so limit instead of ban. (category: lock floodgate; confidence: medium) Proposed rarity: Ultra Rare.

items.name: Denko Sekka
items.context: Backrow floodgate on a 1700 body; removable, so limit instead of ban. (category: lock floodgate; confidence: low) Proposed rarity: Ultra Rare.

items.name: Skill Drain
items.context: Negates every face-up monster effect for 1000 LP; strong lock for beatdown. NOTE: Jinzo Boss Route stage-1 support grant. (category: lock floodgate; confidence: low) Proposed rarity: Secret Rare. (Also on: Jinzo route.)

items.name: Mind Drain
items.context: Current text only stops hand monster effects (hand traps); mild floodgate. (category: lock floodgate; confidence: low) Proposed rarity: Ultra Rare.

items.name: Shadow-Imprisoning Mirror
items.context: Negates all DARK monster effects - hits a huge share of the pool. (category: lock floodgate; confidence: low) Proposed rarity: Ultra Rare.

items.name: Light-Imprisoning Mirror
items.context: Negates all LIGHT monster effects - hits a huge share of the pool. (category: lock floodgate; confidence: low) Proposed rarity: Ultra Rare.

items.name: Elemental Absorber
items.context: One Attribute of the opponent's monsters can never attack; stall. (category: lock stall; confidence: low) Proposed rarity: Ultra Rare.

items.name: Wind-Up Hunter
items.context: Random hand discard piece of the Wind-Up hand loop. (category: hand loop; confidence: low) Proposed rarity: Ultra Rare.

items.name: Chain Strike
items.context: Chain-burn FTK enabler (400 x chain link). 2014 list had it Semi-Limited. (category: burn loop; confidence: low) Proposed rarity: Ultra Rare.

items.name: Toon Cannon Soldier
items.context: Unlimited Tribute-for-500 burn like Cannon Soldier. NOTE: Toon Boss Route support grant. (category: burn loop; confidence: low) Proposed rarity: Ultra Rare. (Also on: Toon route.)

lists.title: Proposed: Legendary board wipes
lists.description: One-sided board wipes: only 1 copy exists in the whole league.

items.name: Raigeki
items.context: Destroys all of the opponent's monsters; named by the owner. (category: mass removal; confidence: high) (Also on: Legendary cards.)

items.name: Dark Hole
items.context: Destroys all monsters on the field; named by the owner. (category: mass removal; confidence: high) (Also on: Legendary cards.)

items.name: Harpie's Feather Duster
items.context: Destroys all of the opponent's Spells/Traps; named by the owner (2014: Forbidden). NOTE: Harpie Boss Route support grant. (category: mass removal; confidence: high) (Also on: Legendary cards, Harpie route.)

items.name: Heavy Storm
items.context: Destroys all Spells/Traps on the field (2014: Forbidden). (category: mass removal; confidence: medium) (Also on: Legendary cards.)

items.name: Torrential Tribute
items.context: Trap that destroys all monsters on a Summon. NOTE: Boss Route support grant. (category: mass removal; confidence: medium) (Also on: Legendary cards.)

items.name: Mirror Force
items.context: Destroys all of the opponent's Attack Position monsters on an attack. (category: mass removal; confidence: medium) (Also on: Legendary cards.)

items.name: Lightning Vortex
items.context: Discard 1: destroy all the opponent's face-up monsters (one-sided Raigeki). (category: mass removal; confidence: medium) (Also on: Legendary cards.)

items.name: Malevolent Catastrophe
items.context: On an opponent's attack, destroys all Spells/Traps on the field. (category: mass removal; confidence: medium) (Also on: Legendary cards.)

items.name: Evilswarm Exciton Knight
items.context: Generic Rank 4 that destroys all other cards on the field. (category: mass removal; confidence: medium) (Also on: Legendary cards.)

items.name: Giant Trunade
items.context: Returns all Spells/Traps to the hand (2014: Forbidden; season-1 calibration had it Ultra Rare). (category: mass removal; confidence: low) (Also on: Legendary cards.)

items.name: Judgment Dragon
items.context: Repeatable full-field wipe for 1000 LP on a Lightsworn boss. (category: mass removal; confidence: low) (Also on: Legendary cards.)

items.name: Gandora the Dragon of Destruction
items.context: Destroys and banishes every other card on the field. (category: mass removal; confidence: low) (Also on: Legendary cards.)

items.name: Elemental HERO Absolute Zero
items.context: Easy HERO Fusion; when it leaves the field all the opponent's monsters are destroyed. (category: mass removal; confidence: low) (Also on: Legendary cards.)
